main.node: Write Leaflet And Offers To SQLite

nodes.name: Discover Leaflets
nodes.notes: exitCode 0=success 1=script error 2=timeout. cwd baked into command since this node has no cwd field.

nodes.name: Query Known Leaflet Hashes
nodes.notes: exitCode 0=success 1=sqlite error. Runs once regardless of how many leaflets were discovered.

nodes.name: Diff New Leaflets
nodes.notes: Idempotency gate: only leaflets whose content_hash is not already in the leaflets table are processed.

parameters.text:
=Leaflet ingestion had a high error rate.
Success: {{ $json.success }} / Errors: {{ $json.errors }} (total {{ $json.total }})
Check n8n execution logs for details.

nodes.name: Download Leaflet
nodes.notes: exitCode 0=success 1=download error 2=timeout. onError continues to Log Leaflet Error so one bad leaflet does not block the batch.

nodes.name: Parse Offers
nodes.notes: exitCode 0=success 1=parse error 2=timeout. Reads OCR output already produced for this leaflet.

nodes.name: Build Leaflet+Offers SQL
nodes.notes: Builds a single shell command that writes the leaflet row and all parsed offers to SQLite in one transaction. Offer JSON is embedded in a quoted heredoc so shell metacharacters in OCR text (quotes, $, backticks) cannot be interpreted. No native n8n SQLite node exists on this instance, so the sqlite3 CLI is invoked via Execute Command.

nodes.name: Write Leaflet And Offers To SQLite
nodes.notes: exitCode 0=success 1=sqlite error. Requires the sqlite3 CLI to support readfile()/json_each() (SQLite fileio + JSON1 extensions).

nodes.name: Run OCR On Page
nodes.notes: exitCode 0=success 1=OCR error 2=timeout. onError logs and continues to the next page.

console.log('OCR failed for a page: ' + ($json.stderr || 'unknown error'));

parameters.content:
## Leaflet Ingestion
Runs 07:00 and 18:00 Europe/Lisbon.
Idempotent via leaflets.content_hash.
Per-leaflet failures are isolated (onError continueErrorOutput) and do not block the batch.
No native SQLite node on this instance: DB writes go through Execute Command + sqlite3 CLI, JSON payloads are embedded via quoted heredocs to avoid shell injection.
